text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for tryouts, where
Umamusume show potential trainers
what
they're capable of.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As the day draws closer, runners devote
themselves to nonstop
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But there is one among them who decides
on an entirely different
approach to
preparing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all. Tonight, the world
shall witness Т.М. Опера О's
glorious road
to victory.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What could one call an act so bold? "T.M.
Opera O, Prelude to the
Crown!" ...is how
it will be known.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Heh. From the name alone, it is sure to be
unrivaled in beauty and
passion!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I imagine what will come, and hark! I can
already hear the fanfare of
angels, ringing
from the heavens!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, all that's left is to wait for the
audience to arrive, but...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, everyone must be preoccupied
with training. There aren't
many passersby
at all.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That student is talking in the middle of an
empty plaza. She's rather...
different than
the other racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (What in the world is she doing?)

text_block_list.text: Oh?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Just as I'm thinking this to myself, our eyes
meet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ahhh! You there! Welcome and well met!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you needn't say a word. I know
you've come to see my most
epic
performance.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: How could you resist? I am the librettist! I am the director! And I am the star! Gifted with a splendid cast—namely, me—it shall be the greatest opera of all time!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Please, take your seat on that bench there.
Ahem, attention please.
The show will now
begin.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: What do you mean you're performing an opera?

text_block_list.text: Heh... It's simple, really.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Listen well. In three days' time, I will run in
the tryouts. It is to be a
grand event, with
much of the academy in attendance.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And thus, I'm here performing a stunning
overture to celebrate its
eve. My opera
will stir talk of the race into a tempest of
excitement!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
But wouldn't the "eve" of the race be the day
before?

text_block_list.text: My, what a peculiar thing to claim. Who decided that the eve must be exactly one day before?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: You know, like, the definition of the word...

text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Again, who ever said that words be restricted to their definitions?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
To be shackled by common sense is
entirely nonsensical.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Why you ask? For I am king among kings! That is why I have been dubbed the Centurial Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And so, what does it matter to an overlord
whether the eve is one or
three days
before? Heh, do you finally understand?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hm, appreciation for the fine arts is an acquired taste. You'll get there eventually.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Worry not—I nonetheless welcome you as
first to bear witness to my
show.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My phenomenal performance will live in
your soul for eterni—hm?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hold for a moment. That pin, glimmering
in the midday sun—is it not a
trainer
badge?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Heh... Haha... Ahahaha! Haaah ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Perfect! I am at this very moment in need of a trainer! For I shall soon be speeding down the road to victory!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This is nothing less than fate! As someone
so utterly captivated by my
opera, you'll
be most fitting for the job!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Do not be shy—take my hand! Come now!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Ah, I see. You are reluctant to claim
such a highly esteemed role
for yourself.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I understand your deep feelings about it. I,
too, become overwhelmed
whenever I look
myself in the mirror.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And so, I offer this amazing suggestion.
Become my provisional trainer
in order to
steel thy will.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We can determine our compatibility
before the tryouts this way!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I shall neither run nor hide. Take all the
time you need to acclimate to
my glorious
presence!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! The curtains now rise on
my triumph, fair trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I try to reason with the imposing student
over and over, but she just
won't listen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So now I find myself in the awkward
position of being Т.М. Опера О's

provisional trainer...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
